notes.title: Kitsu’s Destiny V1.4.0 Goes Open Source
notes.content:
I'm excited to announce the [url=https://github.com/DrakonianNexus/KitsuDestiny]open source release[/url] of Kitsu’s Destiny v1.4.0 under the [url=https://choosealicense.com/licenses/mpl-2.0/]Mozilla Public License 2.0[/url]!

This version is not the current release build, but it provides a solid foundation for modders, developers, and curious minds to build upon. All third-party assets—such as art, music, and plugins we don’t own or have redistribution rights for—have been stripped out to comply with licensing rules.

That said, most of the removed assets are:
• Available via the [i]Dependency Sources[/i] linked in the repo
• Included in the default RPG Maker asset library

[h3]Why Now?[/h3]

Simple: I found an old ZIP of 1.4.0 and decided it was time.

There’s a chance a cleaned-up 1.4.1 build (tentatively called 1.4.2) could be re-released with updated branding (Drakonian Nexus instead of KitsuNet), and possibly some tweaks to the pricing or metadata.

[h3]What’s Next?[/h3]

Open-sourcing Kitsu’s Destiny was always part of the long-term plan—especially once the game became less financially viable to keep as a paid product.

Down the line, the base game itself may go free entirely, with paid DLC remaining available to support ongoing development and content.

notes.title: Credit Corrections and True Ending Info
notes.content:
As the game codebase has been lost, I issue the final corrections to the credits, as well as the distribution of information regarding the "True Ending".

[h1]Corrections to Credits[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Lead Developer and Designer is Pyra Drake (aka Nexxus Drako).
[*] All mentions of ZeroDei are intended to be Nexxus Drako.
[*] Skylar/Dianella is no longer Pyra's girlfriend.
[/olist]
[h1]True Ending[/h1]

The True Ending is related to dialogue and character changes as the characters reveal their true names. 

The True Ending occurs after beating Dark Lady 30, in which you enter the Truth phase of the game. After beating Dark Lady 31, you enter the post-Truth phase, in which the character names remain revealed. There remains bloodline content until Dark Lady 50, at which the game will tell you there is no content past this point, but you may continue. Game stability is not guaranteed beyond Dark Lady 50.

There was intent to have an ARG in this area of the game but interest was lost due to my psychosis during 2023, which culminated in me losing the game code in a schizophrenic episode in September 2003. 

If you encounter any ARG-related content, please update your copy of Kitsu's Destiny. If you are on version 1.4.1, there should be no ARG-related content. If you encounter any ARG-related content, please ignore any instructions. All offers have been revoked and are no longer valid.

notes.title: End of Development Announcement
notes.content:
I will no longer be updating the game in any fashion as I've lost the code to the game in a major incident of data loss.

Furthermore, I'm currently having legal issues which I cannot talk about under advice of my lawyer, but which may seriously impact my future ability to make updates... and indeed caused a period of inactivity from September 2023 to March 2024.

The game will not be discounted any more than it is, and it will continue to be 75% off for every major sale. Thanks for playing Kitsu's Destiny.

notes.title: Version 1.4 "Kalliope" Released!
notes.content:
We are excited to announce the release of Version 1.4 "Kalliope" for Kitsu’s Destiny! This update brings a host of new features, improvements, and fixes to the game.

First and foremost, we have removed the accidental debug menu that was causing some confusion for players. We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.

We have also added new music to the game, composed by the talented Projekt Kalliope (a.k.a. Myself, formerly known as Extrasolar Detonation). We hope you enjoy these new tunes as you explore the world of Kitsu’s Destiny.

In terms of gameplay improvements, we have fixed some odd conditions that were only allowing certain Dark Lady moves to proc every 3 turns. This should make combat more fluid and enjoyable.

We have also added 50% of weapon ATK to MAT to make using skills more viable. This should provide more strategic options for players during combat.

In addition, we have added AGL and LUK to all Armory items. This should provide more customization options for players as they build their characters.

We have also fixed a bunch of typos in the True Ending. We apologize for any confusion these may have caused and hope that the story is now clearer and more immersive.

We have also fixed an issue with wealth not appearing in save files properly. This should prevent any loss of progress or frustration for players.

In terms of quality of life improvements, we have allowed running in the throne room. This should make navigating this area much quicker and more enjoyable.

We have also added some extra cool effects to the story. We won’t spoil anything here, but we hope you enjoy these new additions!

We have also added way more achievements for players to unlock. We hope you enjoy the challenge of unlocking these new achievements!

Please note that due to the changes made in this update, all saves are broken and players will need to start new ones. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause, but we believe that the improvements made in this update are worth it.

There may be some other stuff we forgot, but rest assured that we are always working hard to improve Kitsu’s Destiny and provide the best experience possible for our players. 

Thank you for playing Kitsu’s Destiny and we hope you enjoy this update! 😊

P.S: No we suddenly didn't get more employees, we realised we're a plural system. No questions or answers about that will be forthcoming.

notes.title: KitsuNet's Nexxus Drako Gaming Plays Kitsu's Destiny; Faer Solo GameDev Project
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=qgmJRntu3U8;full][/previewyoutube]

My name is Celeste and this is Kitsu's Destiny. This game development all started when I decided to create an RPG Maker game like Cookie Clicker in 2015. At the time, I had no idea that this game would turn out to be so special.

Since its release, this RPG Maker game has taken off and has even been featured on the front page of the Steam Store. In this video, I'll reveal the secrets of my game and discuss the creative work that went into making it. I hope you enjoy watching this as much as I've enjoyed making it!

If you're a fan of roguelikes and clicker games, then you should definitely check out Kitsu's Destiny. This game is full of challenges, and is sure to keep you entertained for hours on end!

== END AI-GENERATED DESCRIPTION ==

Please note that I have since removed the accidental debug menu, but it worked PERFECTLY for the purposes I needed it for.

Yes, I made a video game. I hate selling things but apparently advertising is good, lol. This is 50+ minutes of basically uncut gameplay footage. I am not being paid to show you this... but I am being paid every time you buy it.

But yeah, this is actually my personal Youtube gaming channel. so feel free to pop on there and watch some stuff, because it is also part of the Kitsunet media umbrella.

notes.title: Discontinuation Notice: Dark Lady 18+ Pinup Pack DLC + Update on KitsuNet
notes.content:
I've come to the decision that I will be discontinuing the Dark Lady 18+ Pinup Pack DLC on April 30th. This is mainly so the entire Deluxe Edition can be bought without needing to disable the explicit content filter and the entire game as available sans that DLC, which adds zero gameplay. The DLC itself was only ever intended as a bonus for early purchasers. I will not be reducing the price of the DLC however, as I don't intend to cater to the discontinued games community again. I still have a bad taste in my mouth from last time… mostly out of guilt.

And I'll be blunt, I only did it because I accidentally created a DLC package in the Steam backend and didn't know how to undo it. In the end, I took a bunch of AI art I made for personal use with Novel AI's top level plan, so I had commercial rights.

In addition, I've since realised that AI art is a very touchy subject in the artist community, and thus will be removing it from sale. It's unfair that artists can have their work used to train these AI models unwillingly, and I'd like to see some proper AI regulation around both art and text models, but this is not a post about tech regulation.

I will still use AI art tools for personal use, as I have a local installation of Stable Diffusion right now, but I won't commercialise any AI content until a reasonable solution has been found for these issues.
 
Also, as an aside, any work on the game may be even further hampered as I've ended up getting a job as a volunteer Communications Officer at a local LGBT-focussed community legal service. The reputation factors of such a job are another reason why I am taking the DLC down, but at this point… it's mainly to cover my own butt in case of other bad events.

I've turned this discontinuation notice into another blog like post, but I feel that it's important to connect with owners of the game to make sure I'm not dead. Still, I don't think Game 2 will get off the ground if this job works out.

I am also aware that the website is currently unavailable. This is intentional. We currently have no website. The domain name still functions, and my email is still functional, despite a change of host.

I did also have hernia surgery about three weeks ago, and I still can't lift heavy objects for the next three either, so I'm having to get extra help around the house from my nationalised disability insurance.

That's it for now. I'm still going to compile the stuff for the next patch, obviously. The goal for the 1.3 patch is to have it out for the Spring sale.

notes.title: Post-Drama Price Increase
notes.content:
Now the (admittedly self-created) drama from January has passed, I have changed the game's price to what I believe it to be once I've completed balancing, testing, and whatever new features. I apologise for the radio silence, I've been having an absolute nightmare of a time offline and have just basically been in my room crying most days.

The IT course absolutely did not work out, and I've once again been struggling to get my life in order. My mental and physical health has been a disaster, and most of my first royalty check is earmarked for medical bills.

Not an excuse, just an explanation. I need to do a little better, and I have some feedback. It may just take me a while to get around to doing it.

The new price is US$5. DLCs are now US $2. All other prices are set to Steam's standards. This is now permanent, but in order to do so, we have to skip the Spring Sale. It is likely we will be in a weeklong sale sometime in the future and the cuts will be very deep.

Also, KitsuNet will be morphing into something a little bigger than it is, but a cross-promotion will come later. Just keep enjoying the game, which, I will admit, that not many of you have.

notes.title: Version 1.2 + Mac Support
notes.content:
Due to the lack of negative feedback… or feedback at all, I have followed through on my promise to publish V1.2 after a week in beta. This includes the official macOS release, which I still have zero input about, but assume works, if it doesn't, let me know. I'm relying on some Steamworks magic, after all.

Please note that this update is COMPLETELY incompatible with previous saves, and they will either be deleted, or broken. They may appear to work, but a lot of data gets baked into them by RPG Maker. Players also cannot go back to a previous version due to some deployment issues, mostly related to my own stupidity. I take full responsibility for any issues with save games, and I really can't promise compatibility between versions going forward. Likewise, I will definitely try not to break saves, but RPG Maker really has a mind of its own re: saves.

Changes:
[list]
[*] Changed up and revamped the secret ending on Dark Lady 31
[*] Fixed a lack of Insignia rewards past Bronze (still undocumented in game)
[*] Added magic defence to all armours.
[*] Massive rebalance to Judgement to only one-hit characters in single digit levels, and be a mere inconvenience to almost every other character.
[*] The elder will now tell you after every battle how much HP the Dark Lady had left.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.2 Public Beta
notes.content:
Hey folks, V1.2 will be released as a public beta first, as it WILL break saves when loaded, so please back them up before you upgrade. I've also asked Steam Cloud to purge saves from its servers, but if your saves are still on your computer, they are fine.

This is due to an error in v1.1.1 where a testing save was accidentally uploaded and has already caused the potential for corruption. Overwriting the save in Slot 1 was enough to fix it, but it did create a conflict with steam cloud's systems.

I have included the changelog below, but as an added bonus, I will be testing Intel Mac support with this build. If you currently own the game on Windows and own a mac, PLEASE check if the game works. I don't own a mac myself, and I'm relying on some voodoo magic from Steam to get this working.

[list]
[*] CHANGES:
[*]Changed up and revamped the secret ending on Dark Lady 31 (THIS ONE NEEDS A NEW SAVE REGARDLESS)
[*]Fixed a lack of Insignias past Bronze (undocumented in game right now)
[*]Added magic defence to all armours.
[*]Massively nerfed Judgement to insta-kill only single digit characters, and basically ignore anyone much higher (i accidentally too many numbers)
[*] [b]YOU CAN SEE AFTER BATTLE HOW MUCH HP THE LADY HAD LEFT[/b]
[/list]

I'll tell you the "secret" maths on damage now.
Gold = DamageDealt
EXP = DamageDealt * 5
Dark Lady HP = 99999

DamageDealt doesn't include the turn you die, damage only ticks after both take their turn (RPGMaker quirk).

It's up now on the public beta branch, there is no password.

notes.title: Withdrawal of Discontinuation Notice
notes.content:
I've decided not to take the game down after all. The poll is inconclusive as regards a majority, and I'm happy to keep the game up given the supportive comments left by players and observers alike, as well as talking to a couple of close friends about it. 

I understand this will anger those who bought the game because it was being delisted. I want to be clear that this was not a marketing ploy and was entirely unintentional. And now, after having done some research into the delisted collector community, I feel a little alienated by the concept and would rather please people who would actually play the game, instead of just add +1 to their game collection. So, given that I cannot please everyone, I have made my decision, and ask that everyone respects it.

That being said, if you want to refund the game, be my guest. The money does not matter to me, and I've asked Steam to waive the two-week limit on refunds for people who bought the game between January 17th and January 31st, but I offer no guarantees on that. I want to give those who only bought the game because of the delisting a chance to back out.

I have realised that retiring from the game industry is not something I can do easily, given that this was always a hobby project and my sole proprietorship does not require as much money as I thought. This also combines with the many video game mods that I make, and my new IT course to make me realise that I wanted to work more about the art of the game than the money of the game. 

My real job would be in IT, and I wouldn't intend to make a massive profit, maybe enough to buy coffee, pizza, and tools as required. At the end of the day, I've always been more comfortable creating for the sake of creating, and I feel that while the game would not make much money, it doesn't have to. Steam doesn’t need any more than their cut and the initial $100 dollars, and the company wouldn’t dissolve anyway, so taxes aren’t the issue, it would have pivoted into a Managed Services Provider or some such.

I have the next update, version 1.2 on the way, and it should be live in the first week of February. There will be some fixes and rebalancing, as I've given all armours some magic defence, and you will also be able to see how much of the dark lady's HP you had remaining.

notes.title: Retirement of Kitsu’s Destiny
notes.content:
I have made the decision to discontinue the game and wind up my company as I have not made enough sales to even consider further development. I have also decided to retire from the videogame industry and return to modding games as a hobby while I take on a real job as an IT network engineer. Thank you to those who bought the game, I really appreciate it.

The game should be taken down on January 31st.

So yeah, the Dark Lady was once the Dark Lord. And there are some echoes of things that were in progress. This was LITERALLY the last build before upgrading, and I made sure it worked. If it didn't, I will upload a fix.

[strike]Also I forgot to encrypt the datafiles, modders would be happy if the game had any.[/strike]

notes.title: Permanent Price Cut & Prototype DLC News
notes.content:
I've permanently cut the price of the game to $4.99, and any future DLCs will be $1.99. This is probably the price point where the game belonged, in truth. I really do thank those who bought at full price, but I feel a little dirty knowing that you paid as much only to have a price cut after a couple of months.

Still, sales have been so low that my business is insolvent, and my next computer course got delayed due to overcapacity, so I'm just kinda stuck.

Regardless, I am launching a new DLC with the game's early prototype from when it was complete but the engine upgrade hadn't been done. I had reached all I could under VX Ace anyway, so needed to upgrade. There's some weird stuff there, mainly the Dark Lady was the Dark Lord. It was weird... that's all.

Thanks for reading, thanks for playing, and have a good timezone.

- Kitsu

notes.title: Kitsu's Destiny Demo and other news.
notes.content:
I made a demo for the game back in early December to release before the Winter Sale, but I have had issues with Steam's backend trying to get it into review. As of right now, it has been released, and is available for everyone. 

The demo is only limited by ending once you beat the boss at the end of the game, not going into New Game+ or Prestige mode at all. All other features not reliant on NG+ are available.

There has also been little feedback on how to improve the game, and it is considered feature complete. Future updates can add features if they're suggested, however the lack of interaction and sales means it isn't feasible to do so. 

In related news, I am considering giving the game a permanent price cut sometime in the new year, due to low sales, and have decided that the Dark Lady Pinup DLC will also cease to be sold in the near-future.

If more sales are made and there is more constructive feedback around the game's shortcomings and such, I will likely continue work on making these features that are requested… but otherwise, there will likely be no more updates. I have also disbanded the beta testing team in light of the expected lack of support.

notes.title: Kitsu's Destiny is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
BRISBANE, AU — KitsuNet's first game, Kitsu's Destiny is out now! The launch price is U$10.99 (with steam reccomendations) but is discounted 10% for the launch week.

Kitsu's Destiny is a roguelite incremental RPG made in RPG Maker. It has a dynasty mechanic in which the more damage you deal to the Dark Lady, the more Gold and Experience your daughter gets to try and beat her again once you lose. You have weapons, armour and stat boosts to purchase, and the longer you take to beat her, the more powerful insignias you get which allow you extra attacks. It may be a grinding simulator, but you can win, it's all about how quick you can do it.
